welcome.title: Welcome to Comptal2.1
welcome.body: This short tour covers the essential settings, then importing and editing your data. The card is draggable, every step can be skipped, and you can leave the tutorial at any time.

language.title: Choose the language
language.body: French or English: the whole interface follows this choice. You can change it later in Settings → General.

windowMode.title: Fullscreen or custom size
windowMode.body: Frame the window: preset, free size, or fullscreen. Apply so Comptal2.1 opens the way you like.

profile.title: Create a profile
profile.body: A profile is an isolated data set (accounts, transactions, invoices…). Handy for keeping personal, association, or a second file from mixing together.

account.title: Create a bank account
account.body: Here, an “account” is only a label to attach imports and transactions — no real bank account is opened. Your banker will not get a call: Comptal2.1 does not have that power yet (and that is probably for the best).

category.title: Create categories
category.body: Categories classify your movements for charts and filters. Concrete examples: ALIM Groceries, SAL Salary, LOY Rent.

upload.title: Import your data
upload.body: Drop a CSV or Excel file, or enter rows by hand. Pick the target account: the lines will be attached to it.

edition.title: Edit the data
edition.body: Categorize, correct, undo with Ctrl+Z. A routine label links a word in the description to a category so it is assigned automatically next time.

dashboard.title: Dashboard — you made it
dashboard.body: Well done, the main tour is over. Explore Charts and Summary. Other pages (Global Finance, Forecast, Invoicing…) each have a short intro, replayable from the Help button.

financeGlobal.title: Global Finance
financeGlobal.body: Four tabs — Monthly, Balance, Projection, Statement — to compare and summarize. Filters (period, accounts, categories) live in the right sidebar.

previsionnel.title: Forecast
previsionnel.body: An Excel-like grid for scenarios, independent from real transactions. Right-click Name to insert preconfigured rows; widgets stay on the right.

facturation.title: Invoicing
facturation.body: A quote generates invoices attached to a contact. Tabs Quotes-Invoices and Items, plus KPIs for Quotes / Invoices / Amount outstanding.

clients.title: Contacts
clients.body: Manage individuals and companies, group them, then open a file on click. Linked quotes and invoices appear from the contact card.

dons.title: Donation management
dons.body: Donors, donations and tax receipts. Three tabs: Management, Receipt register and Items. Generation can validate all donations from a donor over a period.

registre.title: Register
registre.body: Configurable reference documents, PDF generation and attachments — the profile’s administrative vault.

legal.productTagline: treasury, invoicing and donations — a complement to accounting software
legal.scopeLead: Comptal is a local open-source app for treasury tracking, invoicing and association donations (household, SME, non-profit). It is not a substitute for Sage, Cegid, Quadra or a chartered accountant.
legal.scopeItemTreasury: Bank tracking, categories, invoices and tax receipts on your machine.
legal.scopeItemComplement: Complement to full accounting suites: export a treasury CSV for your accountant.
legal.scopeItemNotFec: Comptal does not produce an FEC file and does not keep PCG journals.
legal.scopeItemNotCash: It is not a cash-register system (no NF 525, no POS).
legal.scopeItemNotPa: It is not an accredited e-invoicing platform: B2B e-invoices go through a PA listed by DGFiP.
legal.scopeUserDuty: You remain responsible for tax, accounting and retention duties. Comptal does not provide tax advice.
legal.privacyController: You are the data controller for data on this computer (GDPR). Comptal does not host your data in the cloud.
legal.privacyRetention: Invoices, receipts and supporting documents: keep them for 10 years. Erasure rights are limited by that duty. Early destruction: CGI art. 1734.
legal.privacyZip: A profile export is a clear-text ZIP (SQLite + files). Protect it like an accounting folder.
legal.privacyUpdates: Updates are downloaded from GitHub Releases (binaries signed by the project publisher).
legal.associationDisclaimer: Comptal does not prepare association annual accounts (ANC regulation 2018-06) and does not replace a statutory auditor. Tax-receipt eligibility remains that of the organisation.
legal.invoicingDisclaimer: Invoice legal notices are your responsibility. No transmission to an accredited platform. Correcting an issued invoice = credit note.
